name: Elizaveta Gromenko
evidence: Identified the source paper: 'Cultural Evaluation of LLMs in Russian: Catchphrases and Cultural Types', Dialogue 2025 (Computational Linguistics and Intellectual Technologies), DOI 10.28995/2075-7182-2025-23-117-128; Semantic Scholar id a6653a7201742d979b37db3bb54391e7a94f5c32 confirms authors Elizaveta Gromenko, D. Kalacheva, Ksenia Klokova, Maxim Krongauz, O. Moroz, Valery Shulginov (no affiliations in the API record). Person resolved as Elizaveta Sergeevna Gromenko (Громенко Елизавета Сергеевна), Research Fellow at the HSE University Laboratory for Linguistic Conflictology and Contemporary Communicative Practices (headed by Maxim Krongauz), HSE profile hse.ru/org/persons/856269083/, joined HSE in 2025; previously at the Institute for Linguistic Studies RAS (St Petersburg) working on neography/lexicography ('Новое в русской лексике. Словарные материалы', 'Словарь русского языка коронавирусной эпохи') - co-author anchor (Krongauz, Shulginov, same lab) confirms it is the same person. LinkedIn: no profile; results were other Elizavetas (Presniakova, Dormeneva, Letoshko, Zemlianko, Vaseneva) and other Gromenkos (Elina, Tatiana, Alex) - all rejected as namesakes. ResearchGate: no profile, only a publication record ('Terminological vocabulary in the Russian spelling dictionary') without a profile page. Email: the paper PDF (dialogue-conf.org, dialog-21.ru), her HSE page (hse.ru, philology.hse.ru), ILI RAS (iling.spb.ru) and cyberleninka.ru are ALL blocked by the network egress proxy, so no literally-printed address could be read; guessed/templated addresses not allowed.
